header: A one-line prompt with a button on a tinted band
text: Optional picture, eyebrow, heading, one sentence and one action, all on a single row until the band runs out of width.
note: The prompt, not the form: the button leads to the sign-up page, so the strip never collects an address. The frequency and unsubscribe sentence still belongs here, because that is what a reader weighs up before clicking.
